notebook.title: Commercial Fusion Energy in 2026
notebook.description: Six real sources on the state of commercial fusion: the CRS briefing for Congress, the US deployment roadmap, ITER's assembly progress, IAEA's 2025 outlook and Wikipedia's reference article. Files under tests/demo-raw keep the unmodified extraction.
